name: open theme switcher dropdown

actions.comment: Was a bare `goto http://localhost:3086/home`, which redirected to /login without a token, so `.theme-trigger` was never present.

expect: Dropdown is open, listing the installed themes — each row with an icon, a name, and small colour swatches on the right, the active theme highlighted. The list comes from /api/marketplace/theme/list, so its length depends on which theme packages are installed rather than being a fixed set.
